## Summary
Carlos Javier García Contreras is a Senior Systems Administrator, Database Administrator (DBA), and Cloud/DevSecOps Engineer with extensive experience in enterprise infrastructure, high availability (HA), disaster recovery (DRP), multi-engine database tuning, and system automation.

## Core Technical Skills
- [Bases de Datos & Data Warehousing](https://goldengaco.github.io/#habilidades): PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, IBM Informix, IBM Netezza, Yellowbrick Data Warehouse, MongoDB, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB.
- [Servidores & Cloud](https://goldengaco.github.io/#habilidades): Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu, Slackware, Pop!_OS), Windows Server (Active Directory, IIS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2, S3, Logs), Docker.
- [Middleware & Observabilidad](https://goldengaco.github.io/#habilidades): JBoss EAP, JBoss Fuse, Apache Tomcat, Nginx, Apache HTTP, MuleSoft Runtime & CloudHub, Zabbix, Nagios, Icinga, Datadog, AppDynamics, Dynatrace.
- [Scripting & Automatización](https://goldengaco.github.io/#habilidades): Bash, PowerShell, Python (FastAPI/ETL), Rust, Go (Golang), JavaScript.
